title: Fermat's margin note took 358 years to settle
body: Around 1637 Fermat claimed no whole-number cubes split into two cubes, and likewise for higher powers, but the margin was too small for his proof. Generations failed until Andrew Wiles, working mostly in secret for seven years, proved enough of the Taniyama-Shimura conjecture to close it in 1994, after repairing a last gap with Richard Taylor.
